wire.group_dm_channel_id: Optional nullable group source reference; distinct from dm_channel_id.
wire.references: actor_id/message_id/group_dm_channel_id only; server_id/channel_id/dm_channel_id NULL; no message body, ciphertext, keys or device ID.
wire.source_epoch: Not copied to notification. Exact reply must refresh membership/current group epoch and fence all asynchronous work; historical message epoch may legitimately differ.

invariants: Per-recipient deterministic source identity inserted in the same serialized group transaction as message admission, key-epoch verification and read counts. A notification failure rolls back the source.

No self notification. Muting retains inbox/history; existing unmuted group unread aggregate owns the taskbar contribution. Canonical group rows are excluded from notification badge aggregate to avoid double counting.

Explicit group read acknowledges canonical inbox sources through effective durable source sequence atomically. Sending preserves the existing own-read behavior and acknowledges matching prior inbox sources. Mark-unread does not resurrect dismissed inbox rows.
Member, message and group deletion triggers purge metadata even when SQLite foreign keys are disabled; listing/counting/acknowledging also verify existing membership/group/source.

Postcommit notification callback holds the same group lock during WS push, preventing a metadata push after membership removal acknowledges. Callback performs no database operations. Offline recovery uses the durable inbox.
Group source reference is included in the existing personal data export allowlist; ciphertext contracts remain unchanged.

postgres.engine: Disposable PostgreSQL18.6 loopback container; isolated schemas; removed and process environment restored
postgres.command: Same focused native command with HICHAT_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN configured only in process memory

linux_race.engine: golang:1.26.10-bookworm cached image, readonly source, CGO_ENABLED=1

tests_cover: Body-free metadata serialization and correct actor/source, author exclusion, mute retaining inbox and canonical badge subtraction.
Same-second source cutoffs, stale key-epoch rejection, source deletion, removal/rejoin and group deletion cleanup.

Notification-storage failure rolls back message; removed membership cannot receive callback; concurrent removal cannot acknowledge while source-delivery lock held (actual PostgreSQL pooled connections included).
More than50 sources aggregate independently of inbox pagination; invalid/orphan sources cannot list/count/ack; own-send read watermark settles prior inbox rows without settling unrelated event.
Service postcommit push does not report failed sends for event lookup failure; refresh semantics never mark all unrelated rows read.
Two existing notification fixtures now assert timestamp instant preservation across engines and native PG timestamp column types, retaining SQLite raw storage assertion.
remaining: Client integration and exact group reply preparation owned by separate agent; not part of this server-only evidence.
Real browser multi-client encrypted group message, rekey/revocation and overlay/inbox acceptance still required.
No production mutation, publication or physical-device acceptance. Normal migration backup/rollback review remains deployment gate.
